notes.title: Update 1.3: Oasis Part 2 Now Live!
notes.content:
Dear players.

I'm thrilled to announce the release of Update 1.3 for Endless Desert TD: Oasis Part 2. This update brings fresh content to the game:

[u][b]Update Highlights:[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] [b]New Oasis Biome Levels:[/b] We've added Oasis biome levels throughout the game, including a new midboss stage set in this environment.
[*] [b]Improved Lighting:[/b] Improvements have been made to the game's lighting, enhancing the overall visual experience and atmosphere.
[/list]

A big thank you for your patience and support!

notes.title: Update 1.2.5
notes.content:
Dear Players,

Here are the patch notes for the new 1.2.5 update for Endless Desert TD:


[b]QoL:[/b] Added a difficulty selection dropdown in the main menu to enhance the player experience and allow for smoother transitions between different challenge levels.

[b]New Tower:[/b] Introducing the special tower Missile Swarm, which joins two other special towers in the pool of rewards. This powerful tower can only be obtained by defeating midboss levels, adding an extra layer of strategy and excitement to your gameplay.

Thank you for your continued support and feedback. Enjoy the new update and keep sharing your thoughts with us!

notes.title: Update 1.2: Oasis Part 1 Now Live!
notes.content:
I'm thrilled to announce the release of Update 1.2 for Endless Desert TD: Oasis Part 1. This update brings fresh content to the game:

[b]New Biome: Oasis[/b]
The Oasis biome has been added to the pool of levels, offering a refreshing change of scenery.

[b]Coming Soon in Part 2[/b]
In the next update, the Oasis biome will be expanded into the second half of the game, further enriching your journey through the endless desert.

I hope you enjoy exploring the new Oasis biome and look forward to bringing you even more content soon. Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Update v 1.1 - Giant Spider Boss for Endless Desert TD out now!
notes.content:
Dear Players,

I am excited to announce a new update for Endless Desert TD that brings several additions:

[list]
[*] New boss: Giant Spider has been added to the game, bringing fresh challenges and excitement.
[*] An alternate level for the existing boss has been added, featuring a different challenge to test your skills.
[*] A new initial stage has been added to enhance the early game experience.
[/list]
Additionally, by the end of August, I will be adding a new biome, the Oasis, to the game. This will be included in the pool of levels, providing more variety and enriching the overall gameplay experience.

Thank you for your continued support and feedback. Enjoy the new update and keep sharing your thoughts with us!

notes.title: Update v 1.05 for Endless Desert TD out now!
notes.content:
Dear Players,

I am excited to announce a new update for Endless Desert TD that brings some additions, improvements, and balance changes based on your valuable feedback:

[u][b]New Addition:[/b][/u] I have added a initial new tower, the Plasma Cannon, which targets flying enemies. This tower will enhance your defenses against airborne threats.

[u][b]Improvement:[/b][/u] To ensure a balanced start, one of the initial towers will always be capable of attacking flying enemies, providing better early-game defense.

[u][b]Balance Changes:[/b][/u] The difficulty of New Game+ and beyond has been increased to provide a more challenging experience. Additionally, I've made adjustments to the initial waves of each level to improve the overall game balance.

Thank you for your continued support and feedback. Enjoy the new update and keep sharing your thoughts!

notes.title: Thank You, Players! New Updates and Features Coming to Endless Desert TD
notes.content:
Dear Players,

I want to extend my thanks to each and every one of you for supporting the launch of my game, Endless Desert TD. Your feedback have been invaluable, and I am truly grateful.

I have been listening closely to your feedback and am committed to improving the game based on your insights. I'm excited to announce that upcoming updates will address some of the key issues you've raised, including:

[list]
[*] [b]Limited replayability:[/b] New type of levels, bosses, additional tower types and unlockables (new bosses/subbosses or special towers?) as new difficulty levels are achieved to keep the gameplay fresh and engaging.
[*] [b]Problem with flying enemies:[/b] Ensuring you start with a tower capable of attacking flying enemies and adding new towers specifically designed for this purpose.
[*] [b]Quality of life:[/b] Its is not clear what new game+ is, so I will add some instructions about it. And add a menu to choose the difficulty.
[*] [b]Balance:[/b] The New Game+ mode doesn't feel significantly different from normal difficulty. I will be increasing the overall difficulty to provide a more challenging experience.
[/list]

Some of these updates will be coming next week, with additional content arriving from August onwards.

Thank you once again for your support and feedback. Together, we'll make Endless Desert TD the best it can be.
